### Saul Falls to the Philistines
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/saul-falls-to-philistines
Passage: 1 Samuel 31:6
Points:
- Saul's defeat and death on Mount Gilboa stand in stark contrast to David's triumphs, demonstrating the cost of forsaking the Lord.
- Saul's death along with his sons and armor-bearer brought God's promised discipline upon persistent, unrepentant disobedience.
- By dying in disgrace, Saul brought public shame to the name of the Lord before Israel's pagan enemies.
- Saul exemplified the kind of self-reliant ruler that God warned Israel not to follow.
- Servants of God must not take His grace for granted, knowing He removes leaders who persistently refuse to obey Him.

### Take Control
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-august-20-21-2011.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 31
Points:
- Saul’s demise appeared to extinguish national hope and grant Satan victory, drawing a parallel to how Christ's death was initially perceived.
- Saul's death cleared the way for David's royal lineage, which ultimately culminated in the Messiah.
- Saul’s end terminated an era of failure, whereas the death of Christ ended an era of guilt and ushered in divine grace.
- Saul's tragic end showed human foolishness, while the cross demonstrated the transforming power of God's wisdom.
- Christians living like Saul are called to surrender their self-will and let the Lord take full control of their lives.
